plan.scope: Deterministic native package plan from validated snapshot bytes, explicit source roots and captured identities. All dependency kinds require a provider; no missing weak dependency is silently omitted. Bundled dependencies become direct executable/loader-relative paths and source RPATHs are removed. Declared version-floor admission is not symbol/ABI or runtime availability proof. No binaries changed or loaded.
